title: Baseline with an external analyzer and a platform plugin
description: A finding from an external analyzer plugin gets a fingerprint with no change to the plugin, and can be baselined. Every finding, baselined or not, is still sent to the platforms in --platforms, which track new code themselves; the recorder writes each issue's partialFingerprints (Issue.partialFingerprints(), from 0.15.0) to platform-recorder-output.json. Rebuild the test plugins (npm run setup:plugins) to get the fingerprints in the recorder output. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)

steps.name: --platforms=recorder
steps.note: 0 new issue(s); the recorder still receives every issue, each with its ballerinaScanHash/v1.
